sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pendency of the trial, the parties have settled the matter amicably in terms of the Settlement Agreement dated 09.08.2021 arrived before Delhi Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, Delhi.

sentences.text: A copy of the said settlement is placed on record.
Accordingly, the marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was dissolved Mubara'at Nama dated 04.10.2021.
A copy of the said Mubara'at Nama is already on record.
He further submits that the petitioner no. 2 has died on 18.10.2022 and the death certificate is annexed with the present petition.
7. Petitioners and respondent no.2 are appearing in Court through video conferencing and they have been identified by the IO.
I have interacted with the parties and they submit that they have settled their disputes.
Respondent No.2 admits that she has settled the matter amicably with the petitioners.

She further submits that the settlement/compromise has taken place voluntarily,
without any force, pressure or coercion.
Respondent No.2 submits that nothing remains to be adjudicated further between them and she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.

Consequentially, this petition is allowed and FIR No. 396/2021,
